scope: Independent stdlib-only review of the original 16 saved native B4 before/after scalar objectives. Recomputed only scalar subtraction and native-order mean reduction from raw microbatch entries, not summary values or a handwritten PPO/KL loss. No model, core-loss rerun, DT, GPU, backward or optimizer calls.
source_scope: Imported-source SHA and effective configuration are checked against stored inspection/completion receipts. This independent review does not independently reload the saved remote pickle/tensor files or rerun the official core; its independent evidence is the raw scalar reduction and source callsite review.

native_partition.reduction: Original DataProto.chunk(2), original per-rank B4 order0..7; mean of8 token-means, then mean of2 ranks. The B4 policy-mask denominator is applied inside the original owner loss. No global pooled-token reweighting.

arithmetic_closure.scope: Exported components are individually FP32 scalar results; the original total is produced by Torch arithmetic before float export. A small exported-scalar summation remainder is descriptive floating-point operation-order detail, not a new tolerance or pass gate.

interpretation.dt_actual_branch: Frozen DT-PG loss increases while negative weighted entropy decreases enough for its combined original DT objective to decrease on these saved before/after predictions. This is an observed original objective change on the same64 examples, not a linear decomposition of Adam or evidence of task-success change.
interpretation.different_signal_units: GRPO and DT PG have different frozen advantage units; do not treat their PG magnitude ratio or cross-signal objective changes as a numerical tolerance.
interpretation.regularizers_only: Zero CURRENT PG retains original restored historical Adam moments, weight decay, entropy and KL. It is not pure entropy and branch subtraction is not a component attribution of nonlinear Adam.
interpretation.fixed_old_policy: Original saved old_log_probs/ref_log_prob remain the PPO/KL references; measured before arrays are not substituted for them.
interpretation.limited_scope: Checkpoint25, saved native64, one matched actual Adam update per branch, stored CPU re-evaluation of native predicted LP/H; no fresh rollout/success rate, historical causal attribution or whole-network tolerance proof.
